leadText:
Anipoke Selection (Japanese: アニポケセレクション Anime "Pocket Monsters" Selection) was a series of reruns of 57 select episodes from past series of on The Pokémon Company's official Japanese YouTube channel.

There are 15 episodes from the original series, as well as 7 episodes each from , , , , , and .
